clinical_intent: A brachytherapy plan requires the calculation of the equivalent dose in 2 Gy fractions (EQD2) for a cumulative rectal dose. The patient received 45 Gy in 25 fractions of external beam radiation (alpha/beta = 3 for rectum), followed by brachytherapy delivering 28 Gy in 4 fractions of 7 Gy each. Calculate the total EQD2 to the rectum, assuming the brachytherapy dose is delivered to D2cc.
